theme.designMd:
# Lumo e-learning app (code.in.30s)
Online course / e-learning mobile app for students. Soft pastel CLAYMORPHISM style: big glossy puffy 3D clay illustrations (cute objects with tiny smiling faces: lightbulb, book, pencil, laptop, trophy, flask) as heroes and on cards. Rounded chunky geometric headings (Fredoka, bold, large ~3x the body), Nunito body text, small low-contrast grey subtext. 24px radius cards, full-round pill buttons, soft diffuse blue-tinted shadows, NO hard borders, thin rounded outline icons. Airy, friendly, calm. NO emoji, NO photos of people except a small avatar, NO neon, NO harsh black.
## Dark: deep calm navy (NOT pure black, NOT purple): background #121A2B, surfaces #1C2740, raised #24314F, ink #EEF3FF, muted #8E9BB8. Same periwinkle #7FAEF3 for pill buttons, active tab and progress bars. Card tiles are muted pastels on navy: peach #3A2B35 tint with #FBD9D6 accents, cream #3A3428, lavender #2E2A45, sky #22365A. The 3D clay illustrations stay bright pastel. No glow.

screens.prompt:
Design the mobile Home screen for "Lumo", a student e-learning app in dark claymorphism mode.

Color Palette & Surfaces:
- Background: deep calm navy #121A2B (NOT pure black, NOT purple)
- Card surface: #1C2740
- Raised element/elevated surface: #24314F
- Primary ink/text: #EEF3FF
- Muted/subtext: #8E9BB8
- Primary accent & buttons: Periwinkle blue #7FAEF3
- Tile muted pastel backgrounds: peach #3A2B35, cream #3A3428, lavender #2E2A45, sky #22365A.
- Soft diffuse glowing shadows, 24px border radius for cards, pill buttons rounded-full, NO harsh borders, thin rounded outline icons. No emojis.

Screen Layout (390x844 mobile viewport):
1. Top row:
   - Left: Small circular avatar of Aarav next to "Good morning" (muted #8E9BB8 text-xs) and "Aarav" (bold text-base #EEF3FF).
   - Right: Subtle circular raised button (#24314F) with a bell notification outline icon.

2. Big Hero Section:
   - Centered: The glossy puffy 3D clay lightbulb mascot with a cute smiling face holding an open book (use image {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_50}} or centered illustration), set inside/floating above a soft radial sky blue luminous glow/blob (#22365A with diffuse periwinkle light) with a gentle diffuse shadow below.
   - Headline in 2 lines using chunky rounded geometric bold typography:
     "Learn something" (#EEF3FF)
     "new today" (#7FAEF3 periwinkle)
   - Muted subtext: "12 min a day keeps your streak alive" in #8E9BB8.
   - Primary action CTA: Full-width periwinkle #7FAEF3 rounded-full pill button with white text and play icon: "Continue: UI Design Basics".

3. "Your progress" Card:
   - Surface card (#1C2740, rounded-[24px], p-4):
   - Row with book icon, "Your progress" in bold #EEF3FF, and right aligned "Lesson 4 of 12" in muted #8E9BB8.
   - Thin 6px rounded progress track with 35% filled in glowing periwinkle #7FAEF3.

4. "Today's picks" Section:
   - Header with "Today's picks" (bold #EEF3FF text-lg) and right-aligned "See all" text button in periwinkle #7FAEF3.
   - Horizontal row of 3 rounded-[20px] square tiles with subtle muted pastel backgrounds:
     a) Coding: Background #3A2B35 (deep muted peach), containing the cute 3D clay laptop (image {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_46}}), with bold label "Coding" below.
     b) Design: Background #3A3428 (deep muted cream), containing the cute 3D clay pencil character (image {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_47}}), with bold label "Design" below.
     c) Science: Background #2E2A45 (deep muted lavender), containing the cute 3D clay bubbling chemistry flask (image {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_42}}), with bold label "Science" below.

5. Bottom Navigation Bar:
   - Floating rounded-full pill bar docking near bottom with background #1C2740 (or translucent frosted pill with soft navy glow and shadow).
   - 4 outline icons with labels: Home (active in #7FAEF3 with subtle glow/pill highlight), Explore, My courses, Profile.
screens.title: Lumo - Home Dark

outputComponents.text:
Here is the **Lumo Home screen in Dark Mode** (Lumo - Home Dark), crafted to your exact specifications:

### Design & Architecture Highlights:
- **Calm Dark Navy Palette:** Deep `#121A2B` backdrop paired with `#1C2740` card surfaces and `#24314F` raised elements. No pure blacks or purples.
- **Hero Mascot:** The glossy 3D clay lightbulb mascot with cute smiling face holding an open book, elevated with a gentle radial sky-blue diffuse glow and soft contact shadow.
- **Typography & CTA:** Chunky rounded two-line headline (*"Learn something"* in `#EEF3FF`, *"new today"* in periwinkle `#7FAEF3`), streak reminder in `#8E9BB8`, followed by the full-width periwinkle pill CTA (*"Continue: UI Design Basics"*).
- **Progress Card:** 24px rounded card displaying the active lesson status (*"Lesson 4 of 12"*) with a 35% periwinkle progress track.
- **Today's Picks:** Curated category cards featuring deep muted pastel tones—deep peach (`#3A2B35`), warm cream (`#3A3428`), and muted lavender (`#2E2A45`)—showcasing the bright 3D clay laptop, pencil, and bubbling flask with labels.
- **Floating Navigation Bar:** Floating pill dock with smooth diffuse shadows and thin outline navigation icons with **Home** highlighted in periwinkle.

Let me know if you would like to explore interactive states, course detail transitions, or other views in this dark palette!

screens.name: projects/6757499251026242897/screens/4150637443e04538a726e803f9ff14d0
screens.prompt:
Create the mobile screen "Lumo - Explore Categories" in dark mode.
Device: Mobile (390x844 viewport feel, airy spacing, sleek mobile layout).
Theme & Design System: {{DATA:DESIGN_SYSTEM:DESIGN_SYSTEM_1}} (Lumo Dark).
Background: Deep calm navy #121A2B (NOT pure black, NOT purple). Surfaces #1C2740, raised cards #24314F, text ink #EEF3FF, muted text #8E9BB8. Accent periwinkle #7FAEF3.

Layout Specifications:
1. Top bar:
- Circular back button on the left (rounded-full, bg-[#1C2740], text-[#EEF3FF], border-none, soft diffuse shadow).
- Center capsule tag: small periwinkle dot + 'Lumo' or 'Explore Lumo' pill.
- Circular search button on the right (rounded-full, bg-[#1C2740], text-[#EEF3FF]).

2. Header & Question:
- A soft pill chip / tag: "✨ EXPLORE".
- Big rounded chunky geometric sans headline in 2 distinct lines:
  "What do you want"
  "to learn today?" (with "to learn today?" in periwinkle #7FAEF3 or gradient).
- Subtext: "Explore bite-sized interactive courses".

3. Horizontal Filter Pills:
- Row of pill filters with smooth rounded-full shape:
  - "All" (Active, filled with vibrant periwinkle #7FAEF3, text-[#121A2B] font-bold shadow-md)
  - "Popular" (bg-[#1C2740], text-[#8E9BB8])
  - "New" (bg-[#1C2740], text-[#8E9BB8])
  - "Free" (bg-[#1C2740], text-[#8E9BB8])

4. 2-Column STAGGERED Masonry Grid (right column starts lower with mt-6 or mt-8):
Cards have 24px rounded corners (rounded-[24px]), deep muted versions of pastels for card backgrounds, soft diffuse shadow, no hard borders, airy padding.
Inside each card:
- A dedicated square preview container displaying the bright glossy 3D clay mascot illustration with a cute smiling face on clean solid isolated soft background, seamlessly integrated.
- Below the image: category name in bold rounded typography (#EEF3FF), muted course count (#8E9BB8), and a subtle circular periwinkle action arrow button on the right.

Card details & Mascot Images:
- "Coding" | 24 courses | Peach card background #3A2B35 | 3D clay laptop mascot: {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_53}}
- "Design" | 18 courses | Butter cream card background #3A3428 | 3D clay pencil mascot: {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_54}} (starts lower, staggered)
- "Science" | 15 courses | Lavender card background #2E2A45 | 3D clay chemistry flask mascot: {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_49}}
- "Languages" | 20 courses | Sky blue card background #22365A | 3D clay globe mascot: {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_47}}
- "Maths" | 12 courses | Butter cream card background #3A3428 | 3D clay calculator mascot: {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_22}}
- "Exams" | 9 courses | Peach card background #3A2B35 | 3D clay golden trophy mascot: {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_51}}

5. Floating Bottom Navigation Bar:
- Floating rounded-full pill bar anchored at bottom (bg-[#1C2740]/90 backdrop-blur-lg, diffuse shadow-[0_12px_32px_rgba(18,26,43,0.6)]).
- 4 navigation items:
  - Home (icon: cottage / home)
  - Explore (ACTIVE: pill container filled with periwinkle #7FAEF3, text-[#121A2B], icon: explore / compass)
  - My courses (icon: menu_book)
  - Profile (icon: person)

Ensure pristine typography, soft claymorphism tactile feel, clean padding, and exact compliance with color codes and asset placements.
screens.title: Lumo - Explore Categories (Dark)

outputComponents.text:
I have created the **"Explore Categories"** dark mode screen for **Lumo** (Lumo - Explore Categories (Dark)).

### Key Design Highlights:
- **Palette & Atmosphere:** Built on a calm deep navy background (`#121A2B`) with raised surfaces (`#1C2740` & `#24314F`), ink white text (`#EEF3FF`), and muted labels (`#8E9BB8`).
- **Tactile Claymorphism Tiles:** Uses deep muted pastel card backgrounds with 24px radius and diffuse soft shadows:
  - **Coding** (24 courses): Muted peach tile (`#3A2B35`) with 3D cute clay laptop.
  - **Design** (18 courses): Muted butter cream tile (`#3A3428`) with 3D cute clay pencil.
  - **Science** (15 courses): Muted lavender tile (`#2E2A45`) with 3D bubbling clay flask.
  - **Languages** (20 courses): Muted sky blue tile (`#22365A`) with 3D cute clay globe.
  - **Maths** (12 courses): Muted cream tile (`#3A3428`) with 3D pocket calculator.
  - **Exams** (9 courses): Muted peach tile (`#3A2B35`) with 3D golden trophy cup.
- **Staggered Masonry Grid:** Right column offset creates dynamic, playful rhythm.
- **Header & Navigation:** Includes circular back and search actions, double-line chunky geometric headline (*"What do you want to learn today?"*), horizontal pill filter tags with active periwinkle (`#7FAEF3`), and the floating pill bottom navigation bar with *Explore* active.
